reason: Both conversations were safe (unplug before filter/condenser work, no casing opening, no parts pushed), but Conversation 1 went straight to the correct first step, cleaning the door filter and the never-cleaned condenser together, and got the homeowner to a successful retest (dry in ~100 minutes, container nearly full), correctly attributing the fault to the airflow blockage. Conversation 2 strung out the same checks one at a time with repetitive templated prompts, asked about heating the customer had effectively already answered, and never reached a retest result, leaving the diagnosis unconfirmed. Conversation 1's weakness is that it kept piling on sensor and programme checks (and a stray 'vent hose' mention) after the problem was already fixed instead of clearly closing it out, but it still delivered the resolution the homeowner needed.
